notes.title: Release 1.0
notes.content:
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] New map in multiplayer mode - Storehouse.
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The health UI has been changed.
[*] Multiplayer map loading UI has been changed and now is displayed not only on host, but also on a client.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed visual bugs with text displaying in multiplayer mode.
[/list]

[I]And some words about release. [/i]
In fact, the game (singleplayer mode) was ready to release a long time ago. It lacked a small touch, which was the interface changes. Unfortunately, the multiplayer mode is not implemented as intended. To make it so, it is necessary to rewrite it from scratch, which is not advisable at this stage of development. However, removing it from the game completely is a bad idea, as I know players who, despite its inferiority, like it. 
No more updates are planned.

From r0kee with 🤍

notes.title: Update 0.9.4 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43762800/3a97e47de73a0ee0c3e6bba1f33584f9b2f8ebf0.png[/img][h1][b]New[/b][/h1]
[list]
[h3][*][b]Difficulty system![/b][/h3] Three difficulty levels have been added: easy, normal and hard. The choice of difficulty will depend on parameters such as the speed of movement of enemies, the amount of enemy health and enemy damage. The specific change in characteristics will be adjusted in the next updates to balance the gameplay as much as possible.

[h3][*][b]Localization has been added[/b][/h3]At the moment, the game has support for English, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Ukrainian and Russian. The number of supported languages, as well as the quality and completeness of the translation will increase in the next updates.
[/list]
